class.name: SubdivisionBuilder
class.brief_description: Builds the refined meshes of a Catmull-Clark subdivision surface from a welded cage.
class.description: Refines a cage split over several meshes ("owners", such as a character's head and body) as one welded surface, with OpenSubdiv's Catmull-Clark at Blender's settings (edge-only boundary interpolation, face-varying values linear at boundaries, uniform creases, Catmull-Clark triangles), and returns each owner's refined mesh. Each mesh holds the refined faces of its owner's surfaces with their rest pose, and a subdivision payload per surface: the owner's cage with its skin and blend shape deltas, the ghost cage vertices of the other owners its stencils reach, the vertex stencils, and the adjacency a runtime pass needs to recompute normals and tangents. Tangents follow MikkTSpace's grouping on the refined quads, as Blender's: a refined vertex whose corners fall in several MikkTSpace groups (at a UV mirror, a folded UV) is one render vertex per group, each with its group's binormal sign. The mesh keeps its blend shape names; its surfaces carry no blend shape arrays. Every glTF vertex of a cage vertex must carry the same position, skin and blend shape deltas; a blend shape that moves an owner's cage or ghost vertices must exist on that owner; and the blend shapes that move a cage vertex two owners hold must come in the same relative order in both owners' lists, so that both sides of a seam sum their deltas to the same bits. A skinned cage of several owners needs each owner's bone names ([method set_owner_bone_names]): the skin is compared by joint name, and a ghost's bones are written in its receiving owner's bind indices. [method build] fails and names what failed otherwise.

method.name: add_face_varying_layer
method.description: Adds a face-varying layer: the value of each weld group, in the source's UV space with [code]v[/code] up. The refined values are stored as [code]1 - v[/code], as glTF stores UVs, in [param array_slot]: [constant Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV], [constant Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV2], or [constant Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM0] as two floats. Returns the layer's index, or [code]-1[/code] on an error.

method.name: add_surface
method.description: Adds a surface of [param owner] (0 to 31): its [param arrays] and [param blend_arrays] as an [ImporterMesh] holds them, its blend shape names, the welded cage vertex of each of its vertices, its cage faces as 4 of its vertex indices each from the face's start corner (with [code]-1[/code] as a triangle's fourth), and per face-varying layer the weld group of each face corner ([code]-1[/code] for a triangle's fourth). A UV or custom array is replaced by the face-varying layer in its slot; normals and tangents are recomputed; colours are refined bilinearly. Render vertices are split by UV seams and by MikkTSpace's groups. Returns the surface's index.

method.name: build
method.description: Refines the cage uniformly to [param level] and builds every owner's mesh.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes every layer, surface and result.

method.name: clear_owner_displacement
method.description: Removes [param owner]'s displacement set by [method set_owner_displacement].

method.name: displacement_height
method.description: Returns the height [method set_owner_displacement] gives a vertex whose value is [param uv] (v up, as Blender's UVs), as Blender's Cycles evaluates a DAZ displacement chain on its CPU, in single precision: each map sampled with linear interpolation and repeat in its stored 8-bit values, rows counted from the bottom as Blender stores an image, decoded from sRGB and reduced to its luminance (the Linear Rec.709 Y row); then the height map's luminance times [code]max_height - min_height[/code] plus [param min_height], times the mask's luminance. [param mask] may be null. Returns NaN for a non-finite [param uv] or a map this method does not accept.

method.name: get_fingerprint
method.description: Returns a SHA-256, in hexadecimal, of everything a fixed probe builds to, computed once per process. The probe is two owners across a seam with ghost rings, one owner with two surfaces, quads and a triangle face, three UV layers in [constant Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV], [constant Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV2] and [constant Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM0], colours, a blend shape and fractional skin weights, and a third owner without blend shapes whose surface takes a cluster LOD hierarchy and has a face with folded UVs, whose render vertices MikkTSpace's grouping splits; one surface displaces, through a height map and a mask on its second UV layer. The hash takes each owner mesh's blend shape names and mode and every field of every surface as built. Because it hashes what is built rather than a version number, it changes with anything that changes those bytes: this builder, the rendering server's surface packing, skin weight quantization, clusterizer and cluster LOD hierarchy builder, the subdivision payload's layout, and the vendored libraries. It depends on neither the renderer nor the [code]rendering/pathtracing/cluster_blas[/code] and [code]rendering/pathtracing/cluster_lod[/code] settings, since the builder clusters every surface itself. It covers the paths the probe exercises only: not 32-bit indices (the probe has fewer than 65,536 vertices), levels other than 2, or other attribute slots. A caller that stores built meshes records it beside them to tell a mesh another engine built from one this engine would build. Returns an empty string, after an error, if the probe does not build.

method.name: get_owner_bone_names
method.description: Returns the bone names set for [param owner] with [method set_owner_bone_names], empty if none.

method.name: get_owner_mesh
method.description: Returns [param owner]'s refined mesh after a successful [method build].

method.name: get_report
method.description: Returns the last build's counts, sizes and timings, with one entry per owner under [code]"owners"[/code].

method.name: set_owner_bone_names
method.description: Sets [param owner]'s skin joint names by bind index (a [Skin]'s bind names, or a glTF skin's joint node names in its joint order). Required for every owner of a skinned cage of several owners, and then used for all of them: the skin is gathered by joint name, and each owner's payload holds its ghosts' bones as its own bind indices. [method build] fails when a ghost is weighted to a joint its receiving owner lacks.

method.name: set_owner_displacement
method.description: Displaces [param owner]'s refined surface along its undisplaced normals, as Cycles' [code]BOTH[/code] displacement method moves a mesh's vertices and keeps their normals. Each refined vertex gets a height at build, stored in the payload; at run time the write pass adds the height times the weight of a blend shape named [param shape_name], which [method build] appends to the owner's mesh after its own blend shapes, without deltas. At weight 0 the surface is exactly as without a displacement. [param surfaces] are the displacing surfaces, as [method add_surface] returned them, all of [param owner]. A vertex takes its height once, as Cycles evaluates it: at the first face of these surfaces in the source's face order that holds it, at that face's corner value in the face-varying layer filling [param uv_slot]. [param source_faces] gives that order: one [PackedInt32Array] per surface, its faces' polygon indices in the source mesh; empty means add order. The height is [method displacement_height] of [param height_map] and [param mask] (which may be null) at that value. A vertex another owner also refines must get a height of 0: both owners write it, each from its own weight, so [method build] fails otherwise. The surfaces' bounds and bone bounds grow by the largest height, which covers weights up to 1. [method get_report] gives the owner's [code]displacement[/code] entry: the shape, the displaced vertex count, the height range, the seam vertices a displacing face reaches, and [code]displacement_uvs[/code], a [PackedVector2Array] with the value each refined vertex was sampled at (v up), NaN where no displacing face reaches it. The maps must be uncompressed [constant Image.FORMAT_L8], [constant Image.FORMAT_RGB8] or [constant Image.FORMAT_RGBA8] images, an RGBA one opaque (every alpha 255): Cycles associates a straight alpha with the colour on load, which the sampling here does not model. [param shape_name] must not be a blend shape name any owner uses, and [param source_faces] must not name one source face twice; [method build] fails otherwise.

members.member: The blend shape mode of the built meshes. glTF's is [constant Mesh.BLEND_SHAPE_MODE_NORMALIZED]. The blend arrays given to [method add_surface] are absolute target positions, and the payload stores each shape's delta, the target minus the base. The runtime passes add the weighted deltas to the cage's rest positions, which is the same sum in either mode, so the mode does not affect them; the meshes keep it as their API.
The welded cage's vertex count, every owner together.
